extract_submodule_as_model: extract a torch.fx submodule as an independent model with its own forward function
replace_sub_model: replace a torch.fx submodule in a GraphModule with a new model and recompile
create_sub_graph: create a new torch.fx graph from a list of nodes with specified inputs and outputs
extract_quantized_submodule_as_model: extract a quantized torch.fx submodule as an independent model with quantization and dequantization ops
get_submodule_nodes: get all graph nodes belonging to a named submodule including reference nodes
